newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures rise on cold weather concerns.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures rise on cold weather concerns.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures rose late on Thursday on concerns over the cold weather in the U.S., brokers said.

They said the strength on Brent was driven by the rally in oil product prices, which was lifted by cold-weather concerns after the American Gas Association (AGA) reported a large weekly natural gas drawdown.

The front-month January contract last traded at $23.95 a barrel, up 17 cents from its previous close in London, after recording 30 lots at 0918 GMT. February was actively traded at $23.25, 20 cents above London's close, after registering 233
NYMEX January crude on the after-hours ACCESS system rose to last trade at $25.07, 27 cents over its last official close. February last traded at $24.50, up 24 cents.
